scenes.text: Behind every Adobe product is services work your team can deliver. Which services? How many hours? What is it worth? Here's a first look at the Statement of Work Generator and RFI Builder.
scenes.say: Behind every Adobe product is services work your team can deliver. Which services? How many hours? What is it worth? Here's a first look at the Statement of Work Generator, and R F I Builder.

scenes.text: Pick a ready-made play, or start from your client's problem, and the Adobe products land on a canvas.
Every line is a connection between two products. Click one to see the services you can deliver on it, with planning hours, each drawn from Adobe's public documentation.
Thirty-three products. One hundred sixty-two connections. Five hundred sixty-nine services.
Then enter your own hourly rate, and the hours become dollars: the build, the monthly work, and the first-year total.
One more click turns it into a statement of work on your own paper, ready to edit. Have an RFI? Drop it in for drafted answers with Adobe's sources.
